question: In which year were the first National Games of independent India held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first **National Games** of **independent India** were held in the year **1948**.
 
• The event took place in **Lucknow**, **Uttar Pradesh**, marking a significant milestone in the sporting history of the newly sovereign nation.
 
• While these were the first games after independence, they were technically the **13th edition** of the event, which had started much earlier under British rule.
 
• The **1948** games were crucial in reorganizing the domestic sporting structure and identifying talent for international competitions following the partition.
 
• The primary objective was to promote the **Olympic movement** in India and provide a platform for athletes from different states to compete at a national level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Historical Background:** The games were originally launched as the **Indian Olympic Games** in **1924**. The first-ever edition was held in **Lahore** (now in **Pakistan**).
 
• **The Renaming:** The **Indian Olympic Games** were officially renamed the **National Games** during the **9th edition**, which was held in **Bombay** (now **Mumbai**) in **1940**.
 
• **Modern National Games:** The format of the games underwent a major transformation in **1985**. The first **"Modern" National Games**, modeled on the **Olympic Games** with multi-sport infrastructure, were held in **New Delhi**.
 
• **Organizing Body:** The **National Games** are organized by the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**. The **IOA** was established in **1927** to oversee and develop Olympic sports in the country.
 
• **Recent Editions:** 
 
 
• The **36th National Games** were hosted by **Gujarat** in **2022** across six different cities.
 
• The **37th National Games** took place in **Goa** in **2023**, featuring a record number of sporting disciplines.
 
• The upcoming **38th National Games** are scheduled to be held in **Uttarakhand**.
 
 
 
• **Significance:** The games serve as the **premier domestic multi-sport event** in India, helping the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** and the **IOA** to evaluate the performance of various states and union territories in the field of athletics and sports.
